description: Storage layer, audit service, jobs data layer, and job worker engine. Depends on FEAT-001 (database, config) and FEAT-002 (normalization, docusign client). Implements MinIO and local storage with Parquet writer, the audit repository, and the full jobs service + worker pool including pagination, checkpointing, heartbeating, and crash recovery.
steps: 1. Create internal/audit/models.go: AuditLog struct with all fields matching audit_logs table (ID uuid.UUID, EventCategory, EventType, ActorClientID, ActorRole, OrganizationID, EntityType, ResourceType, ResourceID, HTTPMethod, Endpoint, RequestIP, StatusCode *int, Outcome, Severity, ErrorDetail, ExtraMetadata map[string]interface{}, CreatedAt time.Time). AuditEvent constants: EventCategoryAuth, EventCategoryJob, EventCategoryAPI, etc. OutcomeSuccess, OutcomeFailure, OutcomeDenied constants. SeverityInfo, SeverityWarning, SeverityError constants.

2. Create internal/audit/repository.go: AuditRepository struct (pool *pgxpool.Pool). Insert(ctx context.Context, log AuditLog) error — INSERT INTO audit_logs with $1..$N positional params. QueryLogs(ctx, filters AuditFilters) ([]AuditLog, error) — supports filtering by organization_id, event_type, outcome, date range, with LIMIT/OFFSET. QueryStats(ctx, orgID string) (map[string]int, error) — counts by outcome.

3. Create internal/audit/service.go: AuditService struct (repo *AuditRepository, logger *slog.Logger). LogRequest(ctx, r *http.Request, clientID, orgID string, statusCode int, outcome, errDetail string). LogJobEvent(ctx, jobID, orgID, eventType, outcome string). LogAuthEvent(ctx, clientID, outcome, errDetail string). All methods call repo.Insert in a goroutine (fire-and-forget) and log write errors to slog without propagating them.

4. Create internal/storage/parquet_writer.go: WriteParquet[T any](records []T) ([]byte, error) — uses parquet.Write[T] from github.com/parquet-go/parquet-go to write records to a bytes.Buffer. Returns the buffer bytes. Note: must be called with concrete types at call site (Go generics).

5. Create internal/storage/local.go: LocalStorage struct (baseDir string). WriteParquet(ctx, jobID, dataType string, data []byte) (string, error) — writes to baseDir/jobID/dataType.parquet, creates directories. WriteJSON(ctx, jobID, dataType string, data []byte) (string, error) — writes to baseDir/jobID/dataType.json. Both return the full file path written.

6. Create internal/storage/minio.go: MinIOStorage struct (client *minio.Client, bucket string). NewMinIOStorage(cfg *config.Config) (*MinIOStorage, error) — initializes minio.New with endpoint/access/secret/ssl. EnsureBucket(ctx) error — calls BucketExists; if false calls MakeBucket. UploadObject(ctx, objectKey string, data []byte, contentType string) error — calls client.PutObject with bytes.NewReader. ObjectKey(orgID, dataType string, processingDate time.Time) string — returns docusign/{dataType}/organization_id={orgID}/processing_date={date}/{dataType}.parquet.

7. Create internal/jobs/models.go: Job struct matching jobs table (all fields). JobStatus constants: PENDING, FETCHING_ENVELOPES, FETCHING_DETAILS, NORMALIZING, UPLOADING_TO_MINIO, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED, CRASHED. JobCheckpoint struct (ID, JobID uuid.UUID, Stage, CursorPosition int, RecordsProcessed int, LastEnvelopeID string, CheckpointAt time.Time). StartJobRequest struct (OrganizationID, DocuSignAccountID string, DateRangeFrom, DateRangeTo time.Time, OutputFormat string, UploadToMinio bool).

8. Create internal/jobs/repository.go: JobRepository struct (pool *pgxpool.Pool). Create(ctx, req StartJobRequest) (Job, error). GetByID(ctx, id uuid.UUID) (Job, error). UpdateStatus(ctx, id uuid.UUID, status, stage string) error. UpdateHeartbeat(ctx, id uuid.UUID) error. UpdateCounts(ctx, id uuid.UUID, envelopes, recipients, documents, templates int) error. SetError(ctx, id uuid.UUID, errMsg string) error. SetCompleted(ctx, id uuid.UUID) error. SetCancelled(ctx, id uuid.UUID, reason string) error. List(ctx, orgID string, limit, offset int) ([]Job, error). ListByStatus(ctx, status string) ([]Job, error). MarkCrashed(ctx, crashTimeoutMinutes int) (int, error) — UPDATE jobs SET status='CRASHED' WHERE status IN ('FETCHING_ENVELOPES','FETCHING_DETAILS','NORMALIZING','UPLOADING_TO_MINIO') AND last_heartbeat < NOW() - INTERVAL '{n} minutes'. Delete(ctx, id uuid.UUID) error. RecordFailedCall(ctx, targetService, operation, orgID string, jobID *uuid.UUID, payload map[string]interface{}, errMsg string) error — INSERT INTO failed_external_calls.

9. Create internal/jobs/checkpoint.go: CheckpointRepository struct (pool *pgxpool.Pool). Upsert(ctx, cp JobCheckpoint) error — INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (job_id, stage) DO UPDATE. Get(ctx, jobID uuid.UUID, stage string) (*JobCheckpoint, error). Delete(ctx, jobID uuid.UUID) error.

10. Create internal/jobs/service.go: JobService struct (jobRepo *JobRepository, cpRepo *CheckpointRepository, dsClient *docusign.DSClient, localStore *storage.LocalStorage, minioStore *storage.MinIOStorage, auditSvc *audit.AuditService, logger *slog.Logger, cfg *config.Config). RunJob(ctx context.Context, jobID uuid.UUID) error — the full orchestration:
   a. Fetch envelopes: paginated loop. Load checkpoint for stage 'envelopes'; start at checkpoint.CursorPosition. For each page: call dsClient.ListEnvelopes, upsert checkpoint with new cursor (endPosition+1), update job envelope count.
   b. Fetch details: for each envelope ID collected, call GetRecipients and GetDocuments, respecting MAX_CONCURRENT_DOCUSIGN_REQUESTS via semaphore. Checkpoint after every 50 envelopes.
   c. Fetch templates: paginated, similar to envelopes.
   d. Normalize: call normalization functions on all raw data.
   e. Write output: WriteParquet + WriteJSON for each data type using LocalStorage.
   f. Upload to MinIO if job.UploadToMinio: call MinIOStorage.EnsureBucket then UploadObject for each parquet file.
   g. Update job status at each stage transition. On any error: call jobRepo.SetError, record to failed_external_calls if it was an external call failure.
   h. On context cancellation: stop cleanly, leave job in its last stage for resume.

11. Create internal/jobs/worker.go: WorkerPool struct (jobs chan uuid.UUID, wg sync.WaitGroup, maxWorkers int, svc *JobService, repo *JobRepository, logger *slog.Logger, cfg *config.Config). Start(ctx context.Context) — launches maxWorkers goroutines each reading from jobs channel; each worker calls svc.RunJob and logs outcome. Enqueue(jobID uuid.UUID) — sends to jobs channel (non-blocking, returns error if full). RecoverOnStartup(ctx) — calls repo.ListByStatus(PENDING) and enqueues each; calls repo.MarkCrashed(cfg.CrashTimeoutMinutes). Heartbeat: each worker starts a ticker goroutine calling repo.UpdateHeartbeat every cfg.HeartbeatIntervalSeconds; stops when job finishes. Shutdown(ctx context.Context) — closes jobs channel, waits for wg.Done with ctx deadline.

12. Create internal/jobs/service_test.go: Uses httptest.NewServer to mock DocuSign endpoints. Tests: (a) successful full job run end-to-end with in-memory job repo mock, (b) pagination: mock returns 2 pages of envelopes, verify both pages fetched and checkpoint advanced, (c) cancellation: context cancelled mid-fetch, verify job left in partial state without error record.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./internal/jobs/... passes all service tests using mock servers
